name: teams-firefox-share
description: Firefox screen-sharing compatibility and diagnostics for Microsoft Teams on Linux.
author: manumuxoz

scripts.lint:js: node --check extension/src/config-defaults.js && node --check extension/src/lib/constraints.js && node --check extension/src/config-bridge.js && node --check extension/src/shim.js && node --check extension/popup/popup.js && python3 -m py_compile tools/teams-ss-doctor

scripts.ci: npm ci && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:py && npm run build && npm run smoke && npm run package
